newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Orient set to list B shares next Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Orient set to list B shares next Tuesday.

text.p: Beijing Orient Electronics (Group) Co Ltd is set to list 115 million foreign currency B shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on June 10, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.

The company completed the B share offer, priced at HK$3.08 per share, last month and the issue was more than two times oversubscribed, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

The offer, which gave a P/E ratio of 8.98 times based on forecast 1997 net profits per share of 0.3675 yuan on a fully diluted basis under international accounting standards, was largely subscribed by foreign fund managers, he added.
The company, which produces lamps and television components, plans to use the proceeds to introduce a production line capable of making three million lamps annually, the official said.
China Southern Securities was the lead domestic underwriter and Nomura International (HK) Ltd was the international consultant.
Based on international accounting standards, Beijing Orient posted net profit of 111 million yuan for 1996, compared with 102 million for 1995 and 97.89 million yuan for the previous year.

Beijing Orient now has 376.58 million outstanding shares, composed of 255.08 million non-tradeable shares, mostly held by state-owned institutions, 6.5 million staff shares and 115 million B shares. ($1=8.3 yuan $1=HK$7.8)
